verdict.rationale: Pinecone has a dedicated API versioning page. It documents date-named (YYYY-MM) quarterly stable versions, selectable per request via the X-Pinecone-Api-Version header, each supported unchanged for at least 12 months, plus an explicit list of what counts as a breaking change. Dated OpenAPI specs from 2024-04 through 2026-07 in the official pinecone-api repository confirm the versions exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the policy being honored in practice, and detail on how deprecations are announced or migrated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Pinecone's APIs are versioned to ensure that your applications continue to work as expected as the platform evolves. Versions are named by release date in the format YYYY-MM
Each stable version remains unchanged and supported for a minimum of 12 months
hosted in the official pinecone-io/pinecone-api repository across versions 2024-04 through 2026-07
